name: Runs Program
description: This node runs this program. One verb for both uses: a container runs gunicorn, and gunicorn runs the tap-web application. The source is open because what runs a program is not enumerable (an aws_core container, another program, a host); the target is always a computing_core program. An operating system running a program means the operating system holds its own programs (an init system, an SSH daemon, a shell), and every host running that operating system inherits them; it does not mean a host is executing the program right now. A reference, not containment: no cascade follows it.
